name: django-machina-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is django-machina, a forum engine for Django: a tree of forums,
conversations made of topics and posts, forum member profiles, a per-forum permission system and
markup rendering for forum messages.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the forum foundation of django-machina: the modules machina/__init__.py and machina/urls.py, the machina/conf/, machina/core/, machina/models/ and machina/forms/ packages, the template tag modules machina/templatetags/forum_markup_tags.py, machina/templatetags/forum_member_tags.py, machina/templatetags/forum_permission_tags.py and machina/templatetags/forum_tags.py, and the forum_member and forum_permission applications (every Python module under machina/apps/forum_member/ and machina/apps/forum_permission/ except their migrations/ packages, and the templates under machina/templates/machina/forum_member/), together with the pages README.rst, docs/index.rst, docs/getting_started.rst, docs/settings.rst, docs/glossary.rst, docs/forum_permissions.rst, every page under docs/customization/, docs/machina_apps_reference/index.rst, docs/machina_apps_reference/forum_member.rst and docs/machina_apps_reference/forum_permission.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation
